Playbook.name: Windows — Windows System Network Connections Discovery - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Built-in tools enumerated network connections - netstat, net use/session/config, or nbtstat. This rule fires heavily on the Forcepoint host (websense2 python->netstat, ~92% of alerts) which should be excepted. Triage question: attacker network-connection reconnaissance, or the known monitoring loop / normal admin?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Network-connection enumeration maps active sessions and services for lateral-movement targeting.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security + Sysmon + PowerShell logs via Elastic Agent (verified live). Sysmon event.code 1=process(command_line/parent populated), 11=file, 13/12=registry(registry.path populated); process.code_signature NOT collected.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the evidence story, not any single fact - see ClassificationGuidance.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the network-connection enumeration is attacker recon, the known monitoring loop, or normal admin.

Step.name: The discovery command, parent and account
Step.Purpose: Immediately separates the known websense2/Nessus monitoring loop from unexpected recon.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND process.command_line IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | WHERE process.name RLIKE "(?i)(netstat|nbtstat|net1?)(.exe)?" | STATS runs = COUNT(*), parents = VALUES(process.parent.name), users = VALUES(user.name), cmds = VALUES(process.command_line) BY process.name | SORT runs DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: user websense2 with parent python.exe on hq-fsm-app-p = the known Forcepoint monitoring loop (except it). Nessus = scanner. Any OTHER account/host running netstat repeatedly with an unusual parent = recon.

Step.name: Broader discovery from the same host/account
Step.Purpose: Network discovery alongside account/system discovery indicates an active recon phase, not a monitoring loop.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours | WHERE process.name RLIKE "(?i)(whoami|nltest|dsquery|net1?|ipconfig|systeminfo|tasklist|quser|arp|route)(.exe)?" | STATS tools = COUNT_DISTINCT(process.name), tool_list = VALUES(process.name) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Multiple distinct discovery tools = hands-on recon (not the single-tool monitoring loop) - escalate.

Node.Condition: Network-connection enumeration by an unexpected account/parent, or alongside broader discovery tooling.
The known websense2 (Forcepoint) python->netstat loop or the Nessus scanner.
Netstat/net use by an admin for a plausible task.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-NETDISC-CMD, INV-02-NETDISC-BURST to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: The known monitoring loop or an approved scanner/admin.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the source; ensure it is in the rule exception; close as false_positive.
Investigate the parent/account/host; correlate with other discovery; open IR if warranted.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A monitoring tool not yet excepted.

SOCAction.Item: Add to the rule exception; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the host; if malicious indicators, isolate the host.
Identify the responsible account/process and its origin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; capture volatile evidence; hunt the same pattern across the estate.
Reset credentials used on the host if compromise is confirmed.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Remediate the root cause; add/verify EDR coverage; apply relevant hardening.

QualityChecks.Check: Confirm the required telemetry (Sysmon/Security auditing) is present on the host.
Tune known-benign administrative sources via exceptions, not by disabling the rule.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Host contained and triaged; root cause eradicated; estate swept; findings recorded.
